newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil posts $144 mln trade gap in April's 4th wk.
newsitem.headline: Brazil posts $144 mln trade gap in April's 4th wk.

text.p: Brazil posted a trade gap of $144 million in the fourth week of April, taking the deficit for the month so far to $621 million, the Industry and Commerce Ministry said Tuesday.
Exports in April's fourth week totalled $978 million and averaged $244.5 million a day, while imports totalled $1.122 billion and averaged $280.5 million daily, a ministry spokeswoman said.
So far in April, Brazilian exports have totalled $3.990 billion, averaging $321.7 million a day. Imports have totalled $4.611 billion, avergaging $256.2 million daily.
Brazil posted a trade deficit of just over $3.0 billion in the first three months of 1997.
